title: 藏经阁残简 第十四章 罚期将尽管事再来藏经阁残简 第十五章 夜探废书坪暗收遗珍
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
天光缓缓偏移，落日余晖从阁楼木窗淌进来，给一排排古籍镀上一层暖金。
沈砚收了打坐的功法，体内圆满的道基静静流转，源源不断的精纯灵气在经脉之中循环往复，浑身轻松通透，三年道基破碎带来的隐痛彻底消散无踪。
凝气七层巅峰的修为稳稳扎根，万千上古道韵沉淀丹田，一身实力早已今非昔比。
只是他早已习惯藏锋，稍稍运转心神收敛所有外泄灵气，周身气息再度变回那副微弱平淡的杂役模样，不细看，谁都看不出眼前少年已经脱胎换骨。
他起身走到木架旁，抬手整理方才修复收纳的几卷遗漏残简，指尖抚过竹片，心底盘算着眼下处境。
为期三日的顶层罚役，今日便是最后一日。
等到明日清晨，刘松便会前来撤销责罚，让他重回下层藏书阁值守。
之前刘松心存疑虑，特意上楼试探过他一次，当时他刻意遮掩修为，蒙混过关，打消了对方的疑心。可眼下自己道基圆满，修为暴涨，若是再遇上刘松上门，稍有不慎便会暴露异样。
“明日解禁，免不了还要和刘松打交道。”沈砚低声自语，眼底掠过一丝冷意。
这三年来，刘松克扣他每月灵石，借着管事身份处处刁难，还和陆明远暗中往来，当初他蒙冤碎道基，刘松虽不是主谋，却也落井下石，百般折辱。
往日无力反抗，只能默默隐忍，如今自身实力足够，自然不会再任由对方随意拿捏。
但眼下还不是彻底撕破脸皮的时候。
他如今依旧只是藏书阁杂役，没有正当身份，一旦当众展露修为，必然引来宗门执法堂的盘问，到时候残简道藏的秘密极有可能暴露，得不偿失。
“暂且虚与委蛇，先安稳回到下层藏书阁，再慢慢搜罗剩余残卷。”
沈砚心中定下计划。
整座西阁还有不少堆积在库房角落、常年无人过问的老旧典籍，那些书卷同样蕴藏不少失传道韵，都是滋养自身的机缘，他不能就此放弃。
正思索间，楼下阶梯传来熟悉的拖沓脚步声，伴随着管事独有的轻哼声，一步步朝着顶层靠近。
沈砚眉梢微挑，倒是没想到刘松今日会提前前来。
他快速压下心底所有思绪，面上恢复往日温顺麻木的神情，低头整理手边的竹简，装作一心劳作、对外界动静毫不在意的模样。
片刻后，阁楼木门被人一把推开，刘松负手走入屋内，目光第一时间扫过阁楼各处。

屋内地面干净整洁，所有古籍分门别类摆放妥当，比起三天前满地灰尘、书卷杂乱的模样，简直焕然一新。
刘松眼底闪过一丝诧异，随即又被惯有的刻薄取代。
他缓步走到沈砚身侧，居高临下地打量着埋头整理书卷的少年，开口便是带着挑剔的语气：“三日罚期眼看就要结束，看你这几日还算安分，没有偷懒耍滑。”
沈砚垂着头，低声应答：“分内差事，弟子不敢懈怠。”
态度谦卑顺从，没有半分顶撞之意。
content_en:
The skylight slowly shifted, and the afterglow of the setting sun streamed in through the wooden windows of the attic, coating the rows of ancient books with a layer of warm gold.
Shen Yan stopped practicing the meditation technique, and the perfect Dao foundation in his body circulated quietly. A steady stream of pure spiritual energy circulated in the meridians. His whole body was relaxed and transparent, and the dull pain caused by the broken Dao foundation for three years completely dissipated.
The cultivation base at the peak of the seventh level of Qi Condensation has firmly taken root, thousands of ancient Taoist rhymes have settled in his Dantian, and his strength is no longer what it used to be.
It's just that he has long been accustomed to hiding his front. After a little effort to control all the leaked spiritual energy, the aura around him once again returned to the weak and plain appearance of a handyman. No one could tell that the young man in front of him had completely changed without looking carefully.
He stood up and walked to the wooden frame. He raised his hand to sort out the missing volumes of scraps that had just been repaired and stored. He ran his fingertips over the bamboo pieces and mentally considered the current situation.
Today is the last day of the three-day top-level penalty.
Wait until early tomorrow morning, Liu Song will come to cancel the punishment and let him return to the lower library to be on duty.
Liu Song had doubts before and went upstairs to test him once. At that time, he deliberately concealed his cultivation and got through, dispelling the other party's suspicion. But now that his Dao foundation has been perfected and his cultivation has skyrocketed, if Liu Song comes to visit him again, he will be exposed if he is not careful.
"If the ban is lifted tomorrow, we will inevitably have to deal with Liu Song." Shen Yan whispered to himself, with a hint of coldness in his eyes.
In the past three years, Liu Song had deprived him of his monthly spirit stones, used his status as a manager to make things difficult for him, and secretly interacted with Lu Mingyuan. When he was wronged and the Taoist foundation was destroyed, Liu Song, although not the main culprit, also added insult to injury and humiliated him in every possible way.
In the past, I was unable to resist and could only endure silently. Now that I am strong enough, I will no longer let the other party manipulate me at will.
But now is not the time to completely break up.
He is still just a handyman in the library and has no legitimate identity. Once he reveals his cultivation in public, he will inevitably be questioned by the sect's law enforcement hall. At that time, the secret of Daozang on the broken bamboo slips will most likely be exposed, and the gain will outweigh the loss.
"For the time being, let's go back to the lower library safely, and then slowly collect the remaining fragments."
Shen Yan made a plan in his mind.
Throughout the West Pavilion, there were many old classics piled up in the corners of the warehouse that had not been touched for many years. Those books also contained a lot of lost Taoist charms, and they were all opportunities to nourish himself. He could not give up just now.
While he was thinking about it, the familiar sound of shuffling footsteps came from the stairs downstairs, accompanied by the unique hum of the steward, approaching the top step by step.
Shen Yan raised his eyebrows slightly, but he didn't expect Liu Song to come early today.
He quickly suppressed all the thoughts in his heart and returned to his usual gentle and numb expression. He lowered his head and arranged the bamboo slips at hand, pretending to be focused on his work and not paying attention to the movements of the outside world.
A moment later, the wooden door of the attic was pushed open. Liu Song walked into the house with his hands behind his back, and his eyes immediately swept across the attic.
The floor in the house is clean and tidy, and all the ancient books are arranged in categories. Compared with the dusty floor and messy books three days ago, it looks completely new.
A trace of surprise flashed in Liu Song's eyes, which was soon replaced by his usual meanness.
He walked slowly to Shen Yan's side, looked down at the young man who was immersed in sorting the books, and said in a critical tone: "The three-day punishment period is about to end. I see that you have been peaceful these days and have not been lazy or slippery."
Shen Yan lowered his head and responded in a low voice: "You have to do your job, and I don't dare to slack off."
The attitude is humble and submissive, without any intention of contradicting.
